Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to verify the accuracy of the information provided by the WebSurfer agent in Step 1. The WebSurfer correctly identified that Ralph Hefferline was a professor at the University of Southern California (USC). However, the Planner incorrectly assumed this was the only university Hefferline was affiliated with and proceeded to find the location of USC (Los Angeles) without checking if Hefferline had taught at other institutions (specifically, he was also a professor at New York University). By accepting the first search result as definitive and not cross-referencing with other potential affiliations, the Planner propagated an error in the final conclusion, leading to the wrong city (Los Angeles instead of New York City).
